subject: English Core
title: Deep Water — Prose Chapter 3 - Part 1 DPP

questions.question: Why did Douglas choose the Y .M.C.A. pool instead of the Yakima River?
options: He loved indoor pools
His mother advised it was safer
His friends forced him
He was training for a competition
questions.explanation: His mother advised it was safer

questions.question: What early incident triggered Douglas’s fear of water?
options: A boating accident
Being pushed by a friend
Falling off a dock
A wave knocking him down at the beach
questions.explanation: A wave knocking him down at the beach

questions.question: How did Douglas feel about his physical build at the pool?
options: He felt strong and confident
He felt self-conscious and skinny
He did not care
He felt competitive

questions.question: What was Douglas’s initial plan when he found himself sinking in the pool?
options: To call for help
To swim to the edge
To come back to the surface and grab the side
To hold his breath until rescued
questions.explanation: To come back to the surface and grab the side

questions.question: Which phrase best describes Douglas’s experience when he went down the pool for the first time?
options: A thrilling adventure
A calm moment
A nightmare-like suffocation
A heroic struggle

questions.question: Which line best shows Douglas’s determination in this experience?
options: “I was paralysed under water.”
“I gathered all my strength and made a great spring upwards.”
“I was resigned to my fate.”
“I hated swimming pools forever.”
questions.explanation: “I gathered all my strength and made a great spring upwards.”

questions.question: Why is the title ‘Deep Water’ suitable for this part of the narrative?
options: It refers only to the swimming pool
It symbolises the depth of fear that gripped Douglas
It indicates the pool’s measurement
It suggests fun and adventure
questions.explanation: It symbolises the depth of fear that gripped Douglas

questions.question: How did the experience at the YMCA pool affect Douglas?
options: It motivated him to become a swimming coach.
It left him with a deep-seated fear of water.
It made him enjoy diving and underwater sports.
It made him indifferent towards water-related activities.
questions.explanation: It left him with a deep-seated fear of water.

questions.question: How did the instructor “build a swimmer” out of Douglas?
options: By forcing him to swim in deep rivers immediately.
By using a rope and pulley system to help him float and practice step by step. | | Android App iOS App PW Website DPP: 7 Parishram 2027 English Deep Water (Part - 01)
By encouraging Douglas to mimic professional swimmers.
By allowing him to face his fear alone in the water.
questions.explanation: By using a rope and pulley system to help him float and practice step by step.

questions.question: How did Douglas overcome his fear of water?
options: By completely avoiding swimming and water bodies.
By going through counseling and therapy.
By gradually training with a swimming instructor using scientific techniques.
By reading books on swimming. | | Android App iOS App PW Website
questions.explanation: By gradually training with a swimming instructor using scientific techniques.
